escalation_reason: Whether uv check should accept --no-install-project is a product decision for maintainers. The docs lookup failed (HTTP 403 rate limit), so the claim that uv check inherits uv sync project-installation behaviour is unverified.
rationale: The reporter asks for a new flag, --no-install-project, on uv check, mirroring uv sync. That is a request for new behaviour, so enhancement, matching the reporter's label. No reproduction is needed because nothing is broken. search_issues found no true duplicate: the closest hits (#16257 editable install of the current project, #15215 Docker sync with --only-group) concern different behaviour. search_uv_docs was rate-limited and returned no content, so I could not confirm from the docs that uv check takes sync's project-install options. Confidence is medium for that reason.
